ns2:course.label: Success in LAS for International Students
ns2:course.description: Prepares international students for their transition to campus by examining expectations and focusing on the purpose and value of the higher education experience from a US perspective. Introduces critical concepts to know about academic programs, and engages students in planning their program of study as well as their personal and professional development. Serves as a complement to LAS 101/LAS 102/LAS 122 for students new to the US education system.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Serves as a complement to LAS 101/LAS 102/LAS 122 for students new to the US education system.
